summary: Wetour Robotics Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 17, 2026, announcing the launch of Vantrapower LLC, a newly formed Austin, Texas subsidiary targeting transformer supply and power infrastructure for data centers, industrial facilities and energy storage. No transaction terms, securities, stake, price or board recommendation are disclosed; it is a business-development launch, not a special situation. Management states the initiative will proceed on a milestone basis. The filing is a routine current report incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. There is no deal-term or risk-arb angle.
